# E-12 tables (generated by summarize.py from runs.jsonl)

Median of 3 runs, range in brackets. `appends/s` = records made durable per second in the 6 s window; `p99` = commit latency (ms) from each record's ideal arrival to the fdatasync that covers it; `CPU` = µs of CPU (all threads of the process) per durable append; `rec/sync` = records per fdatasync batch (per window for c). Loads: fixed offered rates and `max` (up to 32 MiB of records in flight, as E-02). Growing files, 4 sync threads, unless the section says otherwise.
